preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in result)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of single-character strings.
The output must contain unique characters only.
Each character in the output must appear more than once in the input string.

postconditions.expression: result == [c for c in s if s.count(c) > 1 and s.index(c) == s.rindex(c) - 1]
postconditions.description: The output must contain characters in the order of their first repetition.
